scheme.name: ICD-11 MMS
scheme.text_source: Titles, definitions, inclusions, exclusions, coded-elsewhere notes and index terms are WHO's own text, pulled verbatim from the ICD-11 MMS 2026-01 (WHO ICD-API container) on 2026-11-02 by tools/pull_icd11_api.py (126 codes). Builder additions — tiers, links, crosswalk, search aliases — are marked as not from WHO.

tests: ✓ G2/H2: a typed sentinel never appears in any request; no off-origin requests
✓ G5: no external script or stylesheet in dist/index.html
✓ G5: no known analytics, error-reporter or font hosts anywhere in the bundle
✓ G5: fonts are system fonts or bundled (KaTeX), never fetched from a font service
✓ H1: rendered text of every route
✓ H1: the map surface — pop-out, association menu (with 2nd degree), every panel, list view
✓ H3: the nudge renders on every field in safety.yaml → deidentify.fields
✓ H4: clear my data empties storage on this device
✓ H5: the not-advice notice on first run, on / and on /about
✓ H6: help lists every pack entry with source and date; no inputs, no branching
✓ G3: as_of is visible on /, /about and /methods; the source of the ICD-11 text is named (K9: WHO's own)
✓ G4: every heuristic result carries its label where it renders
✓ w1: a loop built through the association menu closes on evidence, then one deliberate override
✓ w2: evidence link between existing nodes, overrides, analyses, export and re-import
✓ w3: a relative's situation on a phone, no codes needed
✓ w3: long-press on a node opens the association menu (touch alternative to right-click)
